note.en: Each capital is the NASA POWER grid cell at its NASA SEDAC centre point. Bandar Seri Begawan is the centre of Kianggeh, the SEDAC unit at the city centre.

Each province is the NASA POWER grid cell at its NASA SEDAC centre point. Tbong Khmum became a province in 2013, after the SEDAC census boundaries, so its centre is the centre of its seven SEDAC districts.
Each country is the set of 1° cells it owns on the NASA SEDAC National Identifier Grid.
Each place is the set of whole-degree cells inside a box the team drew.
